digest.component_or_area: live Jira DC harness provenance test
propositions: The test asserts a raw Jira key (RBJNAZV-1) exists in the ticket JSON via substring match, but the inbound path stores only the lowercased local id (jira-rbjnazv-1) and does not include the raw key unless it is a fallback title
The case-sensitive substring scan against json.dumps(ticket) cannot find the remote key because the local id is always lowercased by _jira_key_to_local_id
The ticket payload does not carry the raw Jira key because _inbound_create_write_create_event builds create_data from derived fields and the DC issue has a summary (so the title fallback is unused)
The Jira key to local id correspondence is recorded only in the binding store, which list_tickets does not return, so the oracle cannot prove the round-trip
The test must assert exact id match against _jira_key_to_local_id(remote_key) and additionally assert the binding store maps the local id to remote_key to prove the inbound half of the epic AC
